actual_command.scope: Exact isolated test with observation-only wrappers; no retry, timeout change, rendering addition, or replacement result. Reader metadata only; full successful values remain in actual ModelIR facts. ModelIR.to_dict() is observed directly without populating Diagram display caches.

limitations: Tracing and timestamp collection add observer overhead and can alter scheduling.
RSS entries are only the supervisor's actual completed samples, not a true process peak.
No child import/construction phase instrumentation is introduced.
This isolated run cannot recover the unmeasured historical broad-run cause.
